scientific_integrity: Proof provides support equality, determinant area, differentiability classification, sharp inverse formulas; finite numerical checks are ancillary. Stationary and general LTI volume antecedents are credited.
scientific_limitations: Athermal, harmonic, positive-rate telegraph forcing and specified initial conditions only. Topological support rather than finite-sample inference; no Gaussian forcing or switching-rate identification. Generic LTI reach-volume formulas predate this cusp tomography result; independent priority assessment is outstanding.
title: Finite-time support-area cusps and inverse damping identification in an inertial run-and-tumble oscillator
